remaining: Source errors preserved verbatim and documented in transcription.notes: Задача 1 Г) ends with a period instead of a question mark; Solution 2 В) prints 'интелвали' and 'интермал' for 'интервали/интервал'; Solution 3 А) writes ma_1 = mg + F but then names that acceleration a, while a_1 later denotes the impact deceleration; Solution 1 В) gives two reasons although the statement asks for at least one.

Schema allows only one numeric value per part, so parts asking for two quantities (Задача 2 А) d_1 and t_1, Задача 2 Б) v_1 and a, Задача 1 Д) F_1 and F_2) carry the first value in answer.value and the full result in answer.latex/answer.note. Consistent with sibling papers, but a reader-facing renderer must show latex/note, not value alone.
The press photograph of Felix Baumgartner in the top-right of problems page 1 is deliberately not uploaded as a figure (decorative, copyrighted); noted in transcription.notes.
